mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightening indicated by unemployment rate falling below 5.0% signals strong economic conditions and increased corporate earnings potential, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above historical thresholds indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive equity returns through elevated corporate profit expectations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails when either GDPC1 growth or HOUST growth is below threshold, or 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of joint-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) signals continued economic momentum and corporate capacity utilization, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to sustained earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the signal's Rank IC drops below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.05%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy environment that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.05, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint improvement in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which correlates with increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails when either PAYEMS growth or UNRATE decline is below threshold, or 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of joint-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST > 1500) indicate the beginning of economic recovery and increased consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in improving economic fundamentals.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1500 and the regime is early-cycle expansion, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95 (index 2017=100), it signals economic contraction and reduced corporate output, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to declining earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
